# CPCON Group

> CPCON Group is a global asset management and inventory solutions leader specializing in physical inventory counting, fixed asset management, valuation advisory, and enterprise tracking technologies for Fortune 500 companies across 35+ countries.

With 25+ years of experience, CPCON provides end-to-end asset management services including RFID and IoT tracking, ERP integration, regulatory compliance, and cost segregation studies. The company serves manufacturing, retail, healthcare, energy, and government sectors with PCAOB-compliant inventory observation and IRS-approved appraisals.

## Core Solutions & Services

- [Solutions & Services](https://cpcongroup.com/solutions): CPCON's comprehensive inventory, fixed asset, valuation, and enterprise solutions.
- [Inventory Counting Services](https://cpcongroup.com/solutions/inventory-services): Professional physical inventory counting with 99.5%+ accuracy and ERP integration.
- [Fixed Asset Management Services](https://cpcongroup.com/solutions/fixed-assets): Fixed asset baseline inventory, tagging, and register management for compliance.
- [Enterprise Solutions](https://cpcongroup.com/solutions/enterprise-solutions): RFID, IoT, and barcode tracking with SAP, Oracle, and ERP system integration.
- [Valuation Advisory Services](https://cpcongroup.com/solutions/valuation-advisory): Tax valuation, cost segregation studies, and IRS-compliant appraisals by CPCON.
- [Real Estate Advisory](https://cpcongroup.com/solutions/real-estate-advisory): Property valuation, cost segregation, and appraisals for commercial portfolios.
